about: The system that runs programming contests: it judges submissions and keeps the live scoreboard.

prs.title: A team's penalty time is counted once on the scoreboard
prs.broken: The scoreboard added a team's penalty time twice, so a team with a 30 minute penalty and nothing solved showed 60.
prs.changed: The total now uses the stored figure as it is and adds the penalty only when no stored figure exists.
prs.matters: Contest rankings depend on total time, so a double penalty could put a team in the wrong place.

prs.title: Replying to a released clarification no longer crashes
prs.broken: If a judge released a contestant's question while another judge was replying, the reply hit a server error and was lost.
prs.changed: The "someone else took this" warning now appears only when another judge actually holds the question.
prs.matters: Judges answering questions during a live contest no longer lose a reply they just wrote.
